skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals a 2-hit combo to a single target, each hit dealing 120% ATK DMG.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Atomic Samurai unleashes 30 slashes. Each CRIT slash reduces all enemies’ [Total DMG Reduction] by 1%. Then delivers a powerful final slash, dealing 5000% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG] to all enemies (only affected by advanced DMG modifiers). Ignores 45% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and pierces [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. On the first Ultimate cast, additionally removes 100% of all enemies’ [Specialized HP].

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Atomic Samurai unleashes 50 slashes. Each CRIT slash reduces all enemies’ [Total DMG Reduction] by 1%. Then delivers a powerful final slash, dealing 7000% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG] to all enemies (only affected by advanced DMG modifiers). Ignores 80% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and pierces [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. On the first Ultimate cast, additionally removes 150% of all enemies’ [Specialized HP].

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Removes [Suppression Boost] and [Suppression Guard] from all enemies. When dealing [Specialized Direct DMG], ignores 40% of the enemy’s [Crit Resistance].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 70% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Removes [Suppression Boost] and [Suppression Guard] from all enemies. When dealing [Specialized Direct DMG], ignores 70% of the enemy’s [Crit Resistance].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 80% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Removes [Suppression Boost] and [Suppression Guard] from all enemies. When dealing [Specialized Direct DMG], ignores 80% of the enemy’s [Crit Resistance].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: On entry, gains 20% [Specialized Speed]. When receiving DMG, has a chance to reduce the DMG taken by 40% (the activation chance equals 2× current [Crit Rate]). If this unit is one of the first two allies to act, gains 30% [Crit Rate] and 50% [Crit DMG].

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: On entry, gains 30% [Specialized Speed]. When receiving DMG, has a chance to reduce the DMG taken by 70% (the activation chance equals 2× current [Crit Rate]). If this unit is one of the first two allies to act, gains 50% [Crit Rate] and 80% [Crit DMG].

effects.desc: Reduces the amount of damage taken thanks to the Suppression effect.
Reduced damage taken from non-critical attacks.
The PvP tier's unique health bar stacks on top of regular health, must also be depleted, and can be restored independently.
Advanced tier of direct damage, only affected by advanced damage increase/decrease and passes through normal defenses.
Attack buff gives 30-40% mana and increases damage, increasing by 150-170% when the bearer's Attack is higher than the target.
